description: The usage gap is the size of the difference, whichever of CPU or GPU is larger.

b.request: For processing records joined to `sites` on `zoneref = zoneregistry`, grouped by site code and `insurstat`, return the top 10 groups sorted by ratio descending (nulls last), where each row shows the average of `remaingb`, the average of `ABS(proccpu - procgpu)` per record, and the ratio of that group's average `remaingb` to the mean of all groups' average `remaingb` values (nulls ignored, no rounding; no rows if that mean is null)
b.sql:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat,
         AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remain,
         AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_avg_remain FROM grp
)
SELECT g.zoneregistry, g.insurstat, g.avg_remain, g.avg_cpu_gpu_diff,
       g.avg_remain / o.mean_avg_remain AS ratio
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg_remain IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

c.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average CPU–GPU usage gap (`proccpu`, `procgpu`), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows. The usage gap is the size of the difference, whichever of CPU or GPU is larger.
c.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_usage_gap FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM grouped) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_usage_gap, g.avg_remaining_gb / NULLIF(o.mean_avg_remaining, 0) AS ratio FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

a.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average absolute difference between CPU usage and GPU usage (|`proccpu` − `procgpu`|, regardless of which is larger), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). a.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_avg_remaining FROM grp) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaining, g.avg_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remaining / NULLIF(o.mean_avg_remaining, 0) AS ratio FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

d.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), and the average usage gap, defined as the absolute difference between CPU and GPU usage (`proccpu`, `procgpu`), taking whichever is larger. Also show the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values, ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing. Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
d.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb,
         AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_usage_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg_remaining_gb FROM grouped
)
SELECT g.zoneref,
       g.insurstat,
       g.avg_remaining_gb,
       g.avg_usage_gap,
       g.avg_remaining_gb / NULLIF(o.mean_avg_remaining_gb, 0) AS remaining_ratio
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.mean_avg_remaining_gb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
